raw_recipe.headline: Aileen's Punch
raw_recipe.description: Pineapple juice, apricot nectar and limeade concentrate are combined with lemon-lime soda.
raw_recipe.name: Aileen's Punch

recipeInstructions.text: In a punch bowl combine pineapple juice, apricot nectar and limeade; finally, pour in the lemon-lime soda.

review.reviewBody: incredible punch!! I had to make multiple copies for my book club. You can find the apricot nectar in the mexican foods section (look for Jumex brand juices).

We used this punch for our wedding reception. It was super simple to mix up and tasted great! We pre-mixed and refrigerated everything but the soda in gallon jugs to make it easy for the servers. We also added slices of lemon and orange to make it look fancy.

Very good punch that was well received at my party by adults and kids alike. Instead of apricot nectar, I pureed lite canned apricots (only apricots, water and sugar in the ingredients list) in the blender before the party. I reserved the puree in the fridge until it was time to make the punch, which kept the preparation quick. I also provided a bottle of vodka and a bottle of cherry amaretto on the side, and the adults enjoyed spiking their drinks.

I have been using this recipe for over 25 years - the way I was introduced to it was the juices & limeade were in a frozen state (already mixed together) - brought out to partially thaw b-4 the party & when it was ready to serve the 7-up was poured over it & was a slushy drink. FABULOUS!!! Of course we spiked it with vodka to get the party started!! :)

I made this for my daughter's Senior Recital. It was great and so easy. The punch bowl was too small to fit a whole recipe at once, so I mixed all of the ingredients except the soda in a gallon jug. I then added half of this mix and one liter of soda to the punch bowl each time it needed to be refilled. I actually made three batches, and used one jug for each batch so that I could keep track of how much soda to put in. It was a great success - even the folks who don't usually like punch came back for seconds. We had coffee too, but almost nobody had any, even though it was a cold night - the punch was just too pretty and tasty.

We served this punch at my parent's 50th Wedding anniversary party. It was a big hit! I couldn't find limeade, so I used Bacardi Margarita frozen concentrate instead. I also made an ice ring with lemon, lime and pineapple frozen in it.

It was very good...made it for a baby shower. Certainly easy, which is what I was looking for. Several people complimented on it. Made an ice ring the night before in a Budnt pan using extra peach nectar and pineapple juice. Added slices of fresh oranges, lemons and maraschino cherries. Looked very pretty in the punch bowl and kept it chilled without diluting the taste.

Mmm, this was so good and refreshing, not overwhelmingly sweet like many punches. I couldn't find a big can of apricot nectar, so I used four small cans of peach nectar. Also, I used diet 7-Up. By the way, it calls for the small can of limeade, I didn't figure that out until after I shopped, so I just used half of the big one.
I have made this punch for both my daughter's and daughter-in-law's showers. Huge success. Apricot nectar gives it a different, smooth flavor. Mixes well with champagne.
Love this recipe and the ease of ingredients. I also like the way to change the calculator for servings. I substituted the lemon-lime pop with Fresca
I thought the punch was on the bitter side. I altered it by adding some orange juice, less apricot nectar, and using lemonade instead of the limeade concentrate. This made for a smoother punch.
Great punch, don't like the fizz with the pineapple juice though, much better taste the next day when the soda went flat.

I served this punch at my daughters wedding shower yesterday. It was huge hit!!! I loved it! The reviews are correct, it's not overly sweet like so many punch recipes are! It was just perfect! Thank you for this great recipe!

I've made this for dozens of relatives and friends and it's always been a hit! I've been asked about it every time and despite wanting to claim it for my own, I can't help but give credit to the mysterious Aileen. Just a well-balanced drink with just the right amount of fruity sweet, lightly carbonated tang that holds up well, even when it's been mixed with ice for a few hours.

Was looking for a punch that had a lot of juice in it for my daughter's birthday party. She absolutely loves juice and this was a big hit with her. We couldn't find apricot nectar so I used 46oz of V8 Peach Mango juice instead. We added a little sugar to make it less bitter but other than that we all loved this. The peach mango was perfect with this and I'd recommend it for a supplement if you can't find the apricot.
Scaled this down for 4 people and it Was a huge hit. Guests kept going back for more. Couldn't find apricot though so I had to use peach.
This was all gone at the end of my pool party. I didn't get to taste it, but I'm giving it 5 stars based on not one single drop being left!
I made this for a baby shower using mango instead of apricot juice. People seemed to like it, I did not have any left.
I recently made this recipe for a banquet, and everyone loved it. We had about 140 people, and I made 6 batches. I would do 7 next time.
PUNCH is a KNOCKOUT! The recipe was very easy. My co-workers loved it!
